mcp.title: MCP Service
mcp.description: Expose your collection to AI assistants over MCP, and let them query, summarize and organize your goods.
mcp.enableServiceDesc: When enabled, local AI clients can access your collection through the HTTP endpoint
mcp.statusRunningDesc: Page connected to the dev server; AI clients can call tools now
mcp.statusWaitingDesc: Cannot reach the dev server. Make sure npm run dev is running
mcp.tokenHint: The token grants full read access to your data — only share it with trusted AI clients. Override with the GOODS_MCP_TOKEN env variable
mcp.qrAlt: QR code of the server URL
mcp.qrHint: Devices on the same LAN can scan to get the server URL
mcp.adbReverseHint: Run this on your computer while the phone is connected, then point clients to http://127.0.0.1:{port}/mcp
mcp.securityNote: Security note: the token grants read access to your entire collection and spending data. Never share it with untrusted clients or screenshots.
mcp.devNotice: Dev preview: the endpoint is provided by the Vite dev server. Native Android support is coming in a later release.
mcp.nativeNotice: The endpoint is provided by the built-in HTTP service and only available while the app is running; use adb reverse on your computer first.
mcp.entryMeta: Let AI assistants read your collection over MCP
mcp.portHint: The service restarts automatically after a change; external AI clients connect through this port
mcp.statusRunningNative: Built-in HTTP service is running; AI clients can call tools
mcp.allowWritesDesc: When enabled, external AI clients can add/modify/delete data and change some settings; read-only when off. Start the desktop dev server with GOODS_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=1 to apply
